name: RadNet Inc.
summary:
RadNet (RDNT) reported earnings of $0.29 per share on revenue of $622.72 million for the . The consensus earnings estimate was $0.18 per share on revenue of $611.91 million. The company beat consensus estimates by 61.11% while revenue grew 24.99% on a year-over-year basis.

RadNet Inc is a provider of freestanding, fixed-site outpatient diagnostic imaging services in the United States. Its services include magnetic resonance imaging, computed tomography, positron emission tomography, nuclear medicine, and among others.
subject: RadNet Beat Consensus Estimates
